name: – After § 21 – Am 9
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the need to reduce work-related fatalities
part_text: 21b. Calls on the Commission to assess and propose EU-level measures to ensure that public procurement does not reward the lowest bid at the expense of occupational health and safety, including by strengthening training for contracting authorities, promoting occupational safety and health training requirements for economic operators and, where relevant, subcontractors, enabling the exclusion of operators convicted of serious breaches, and ensuring effective controls and dissuasive sanctions during contract performance;
